answer_1.quote: We first create preference-based training data using a multi-agent, recursive tree-based paradigm. Our data is sourced from a question-answering (QA) setting where two LLMs debate each other, acting as both speakers and listeners to create a dialogue tree encoding different ways a conversation could go.

answer_2.quote: We use the 'Are you sure?' evaluation to measure flipflopping... reporting initial and final accuracy.
